content_sections.heading: MPSC Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the MPSC Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download MPSC Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.text: Minimum Age: 21 years Maximum Age: 40 years Age relaxation is applicable for ST/SC candidates up to 5 years. Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

content_sections.text: The selected candidates will be appointed at Level-11 in the Pay Matrix.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the MPSC Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 16-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of MPSC to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the MPSC Senior Grade of MHS recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the MPSC Senior Grade of MHS (Specialist Sub-Cadre) posts is 16th September 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Grade of MHS posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies announced for the Senior Grade of MHS (Specialist Sub-Cadre) positions by the Mizoram Public Service Commission.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 40 years for all the advertised posts. Age relaxation is provided for specific categories.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the MPSC recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS Degree along with a Post Graduate Degree or Diploma in the concerned speciality. A valid registration with the Mizoram State Medical Council is also mandatory.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Senior Grade of MHS posts?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will be placed at Level-11 in the Pay Matrix, which offers a competitive salary as per government norms.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply for the MPSC recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the official MPSC website. The application process involves filling out the form, uploading documents, and paying the fee, if applicable.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the PwBD category?
faq.answer: No, candidates belonging to the PwBD category are exempted from paying any application fee for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection of candidates will be based on a Direct Recruitment Examination conducted by the Mizoram Public Service Commission.

faq.question: Q9. Does MPSC offer any age relaxation?
faq.answer: Yes, the upper age limit is relaxable up to 5 years for candidates belonging to the Scheduled Tribe (ST) and Scheduled Caste (SC) categories.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is highly recommended to read the notification thoroughly before applying.
